subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental, persisted `claws status`/`claws remove` ownership and recovery contract in core once the final cleanup proof is supplied?
rationale: The patch is a new destructive lifecycle surface spanning agent config, sessions, workspace files, package ownership, and SQLite provenance; the repository policy requires owner judgment for that compatibility-sensitive product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the lifecycle contract
options.body: Approve the core experimental direction after the contributor supplies final-head proof for referenced cleanup and forced conflicts, then land it in the reviewed stack order.

options.title: Keep status read-only
options.body: Accept inspection only and defer destructive removal until maintainers choose a longer-term ownership and recovery contract.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Leave the series unmerged until maintainers choose a different lifecycle or plugin boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the lifecycle contract
recommendation.body: Approve the core experimental direction after the contributor supplies final-head proof for referenced cleanup and forced conflicts, then land it in the reviewed stack order.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent shared-state, config, and filesystem-safety work best matches the cross-cutting contract decision.
